messages:
sarah_marketing: Hey team — final QA request for the webinar launch + post-event nurture drip. Draft email copy and variants are in Figma: https://figma.redwood/workspace/webinar-launch. Can folks skim segmentation rules and subject lines today? We want to lock send windows by EOD so Growth can schedule.

joseph_growth: On it. Quick Q — are we treating trial users differently in the invite?

sarah_marketing: Yes — trial users get a priority invite with a CTA to book a 1:1. Public leads get standard invite + CTA to add to calendar.

anya_content: Subject line suggestions (A/B):
- A: "Join our webinar: Reduce LLM inference costs by 3x"
- B: "How top teams cut LLM token bills — live demo"
Which tone do we want? data-driven or product-story?

joseph_growth: I prefer B for cold inbound, A for warm (trial/activated). Also recommend adding a short preview text for mobile: "Demo + real numbers — Tues 10am PT"

sam_eng: segmentation rules look fine but please add suppression for 'opted-out' and 'no-email' flags. Also add exclusion for accounts on Dedicated private installs (they get rep outreach).

sarah_marketing: Good catch. Updated segment snippet below — can someone confirm logic?

```
Segment: webinar_invite_final_v3
include: leads.created_30d, leads.interest_tag:webinar, not leads.opted_out
priority: if user.status=="trial_active" -> cohort: "trial_priority"
exclude: accounts.deployment_type=="private" OR leads.no_email==true
split: warm=10k, cold=50k (sample)
send_windows: Tues/Wed 9-11am PT
A/B: subject_A_for_warm, subject_B_for_cold
```

anya_content: Looks good. For the drip after the event: non-attendees get a 3-email nurture (1: highlight + recording, 2: customer case, 3: ask-to-demo). Attendees get follow-up survey + 2-step nurture.

joseph_growth: Can ops-bot run an audience size estimate after exclusion? I want to check capacity and throttles.

ops-bot: audience_estimate running... ETA ~2m

ops-bot: audience_estimate complete — estimated recipients after suppression: warm 8,742; cold 46,130. Throttle advice: schedule in 6 waves over 3 hours to avoid SMTP provider rate limits.

sam_eng: Add UTM params please: utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026. Also ensure we strip preview pane images to reduce spam scores.

sarah_marketing: Will update copy + UTMs. Can someone sign off on subject lines so I can finalize templates? Need one approver from content + one from growth.

anya_content: Content sign-off: ✅ prefer mix approach (A for warm, B for cold).

joseph_growth: Growth sign-off: ✅ will queue once templates are pushed.

sarah_marketing: Awesome — I'll push final templates to the email repo and ping @joseph_growth when ready. Thanks all :rocket:
